Import Employees from CSV

Expected columns (any order, header names matched automatically): Emp Code, Employee Name, Father Name, Mother Name, Contact Number, CNIC No., Bank Name, Emp A/C No., IBAN No., Account Title, Date Of Birth, Email Address, Nationality, Designation, Joining Date, End Date, Address, Gross Salary, Shift Start, Shift End, Status. Shift Start/Shift End: 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 09:00, 17:30) — 12-hour "9:00 AM"/"5:30 PM" also works. An existing employee is matched by Emp Code (e.g. "9" and "09" are treated as the same code) and updated — its Employee Name is left as-is (Attendance/Payroll/JLR all depend on it staying exactly what it is; rename someone from the Employees form instead); a new Emp Code creates a brand-new employee — no login access is granted by import, that stays a separate step. CNIC and Contact Number are reformatted automatically either way.

Import Customers / Vendors from CSV

Needs a Name column (also recognizes "Business Partner Name (Vendor)"/"Customer Name"). Also picks up Address, Contact No./Phone, Contact Person, Payment Type/Terms and CNIC when present — anything else can be filled in later by editing the record. A row whose name already matches an existing record is merged into it (becomes "Both" if the types differ) instead of creating a duplicate, and never overwrites a field that's already filled in.

Import Equipment Catalog from CSV

The Equipment / Standards / Item Descriptions sheet (Equipment on its own row, one Standard per column below it, then Item Descriptions column-aligned to each Standard). Re-uploading an updated version of the same sheet only adds what's new — nothing already on file gets duplicated.

Add Equipment / Standard / Item Description

Search an existing entry at each level, or use "+ New" to add one that isn't on file yet — it saves immediately.

New RFQ

However the RFQ actually arrived (call, email, PDF) — just key in what it says below. It gets a fixed Serial No. (financial-year format, e.g. 2026-27/001) the moment you save.

New RFQ / Quotation

Fill this once — on save it creates an RFQ and a linked Quotation as two separate records. The RFQ's items are taken from the line items below.

Edit Quotation

Quotation Terms Template

One shared block, written once — it prints on the terms page(s) of every Quotation PDF. Use the toolbar for headings / emphasis / size.
